configurePresets.name: linux-core
configurePresets.displayName: Native core + CLI (host, GCC or Clang)
configurePresets.description: From docs/dev-environment.md: core and CLI built natively with ASan/UBSan and -Werror. This is the profile most development happens under (ADR-0010 section 4). -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti are applied at target level to src/core and src/backends, not here: the test framework needs RTTI (see CMakeLists.txt).

configurePresets.name: win-cross-x64
configurePresets.description: The shipped configuration: cross-compiled from Linux with the pinned LLVM-MinGW toolchain (ADR-0010 section 2). Release builds land at build/win-cross-x64/Release/. The toolchain pin lives in build/cmake/toolchain-llvm-mingw.cmake and the hash in third_party/toolchains/llvm-mingw.sha256.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc
configurePresets.description: The parity configuration that runs on a windows-latest runner (ADR-0010 section 3): the same CMake targets through the MSVC toolset, so toolchain divergence shows up on the PR. Deliberately not the local loop - nobody is asked to drive cl.exe through WSL interop. Ninja plus the Developer PowerShell environment is used instead of a Visual Studio generator, so the job does not pin a runner image's Visual Studio version (the runner moved from VS 2022 to 2026).
